question: Which of the following is a genetically modified plant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bt cotton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bt cotton **

 
 
• Bt cotton is the only permitted GM crop in India.
 
• In which the soil is obtained by hybridization of two foreign genes with the bacterium "Bacillus thuringiensis" (BT).
 
• These genes help the cotton crop secrete a toxic protein to protect it from an insect called the common pink bollworm.​
 
• Some strains of Bt produce proteins that kill certain insects such as lepidopterans, coleopterans, and dipterans.
 
• Bt forms protein crystals during a particular phase of their growth.
 
• These crystals contain a toxic insecticidal protein.
 
 
 
• Sugarcane, Wild bananas,Native potatoes are natural crops.
